description: Agent-authored held-out paraphrases; not human gold labels or downstream Cypher accuracy

queries.question: For August, break my finished work down into the four task measures for every delivery.
我在各项研究做了多少工作，占整个研究工作总量的百分比是多少？
Show me the elapsed labour and output-item quantities side by side for each of my delivery IDs.
过去一个季度我最熟悉和最少碰到的SDTM域分别是什么？请把次数也列出来。
Arrange my previous study assignments first by therapeutic area, then by data domain.
For a selected protocol, total the effort I recorded during the latest fourteen days.
用我近半年的记录算一算，平均做一项任务要几小时？
Which delivery absorbed the biggest share of my effort recently, looking only at the last fortnight?
为我的直属员工填写PLI准备半年度业绩依据，包括研究数、输出量和任务量。
What unfinished commitments are due over the coming fortnight, and in what order should I tackle them?
把我手头正在进行的交付逐条列出，并算出距离截止日期还有几天。
As the study programming lead, what delivery commitments fall within the coming quarter?
我的LoT分工里编程和复核各有多少，能据此看出后续负担吗？
Count next month's assigned figures, listings and tables separately for production and checking.
按既往做事速度，未来一个季度这些工作大概要占我多少小时？
Give me this week's final dLoT assignments, grouped under their protocols with generator and checker roles.
If my weekly budget is forty working hours, how should it be divided across the projects I support?
请比较我去年上半年与下半年的产出效率和每项任务所花时间。
For a protocol of my choosing, show the finished delivery milestones and how actual dates differed from the plan.
我们DU各位同事做过哪些研究，又实际接触过什么域？
Contrast my team's delivered workload in the two semesters of a given year.
从今年二月开始，我的组员完成任务数和全部门人均水平相比如何？
Build a member-by-member account of our recent completed work alongside the commitments ahead.
未来几个月里，哪些组员和我本人完全没有交付安排？先看下个月。
Break the team's forward task plan into a grid of people and calendar months.
我负责的DU未来交付任务量比同一部门其他DU高还是低？
Within one study delivery, what did each contributor deliver, and how large was their share of the combined work?
针对一个指定DID，请给出所有参与者的累计工时及逐月明细。
Find this month's deliveries whose reporting descriptions mention CSR.
两个交付版本的数据集与输出清单有哪些新增和缺失？
For this delivery, deduplicate the output titles and count the distinct ones under each source domain.
未来两个月我的哪些交付可能撞期，需要同时处理？
Find the work assigned to me that has no corresponding time entry anywhere in its history.
根据过去和未来季度任务量的变化，哪些人可能变成资源瓶颈？
Prepare the TA leader's next fortnight delivery briefing for everyone further down the reporting tree.
这个DID在什么平台执行？把CDARS或者SIGMA的目录位置给我。
I need an example output for an unfamiliar topic; which deliveries have a title close to the one I describe?
某张表在哪次最新交付里能找到？按实际日期找最近版本。
Across which delivery IDs has this same named output been used?
找出不同DID之间重名的表格，看看有哪些交付共用了标题。
Who programmed and independently checked the outputs sourced from ADLB in the chosen protocol?
给我这个交付各张TLF的正式编号，而不是只给标题。
Which colleagues in my immediate team have worked on survival curves and could help with a rush assignment?
需要找个懂统计建模的同事请教，从历史输出经验看谁合适？
Look at the study's successive versions and point out when the analysis-dataset programmer or checker changed.
选定季度里，哪十项研究的已完成TLF输出量最大？也要负责人信息。
List protocols led by an SDSL based in the Indian office, including their study milestone information.
只看目前活跃的三期研究，列出SDSL和上级负责人。
For one delivery ID I want the complete inventory: datasets, outputs, assigned programmers, checkers and file identifiers.
某研究正在做的人员还同时承担哪些其他研究的活跃交付？
Compare offices year by year on finished delivery output, logged effort and effort per task.
在一个TA负责人范围内，按各组负责人比较已交付工作及耗时。
For my chosen study, who owns each SDTM or analysis domain, and which colleagues collaborated with them during a selected interval?
既想看团队近期每个DID耗时和任务量，也想知道下个月各成员预计工作多少。
Show the full delivery list for a protocol and locate its responsible study lead.
给同事安排新的Kaplan-Meier输出之前，先查谁有相关经验，再看看这些人的其他活跃交付。
Summarize a programmer's therapeutic-area experience, then suggest unfamiliar studies or domains they could take on next.
这项申报由谁牵头？另外请列出所选研究参与交付的人员。
For the selected study, compare ownership handoffs across versions separately for tables and for tabulation domains.
先查自己现在可填日报的交付编号，再查哪些已分配交付一直没有工时记录。
